decisions.title: Linux cask artifact subset
decisions.question: Which cask artifact kinds (binary, approved appimage) does Linux implement versus refuse?
decisions.default_policy: constrained-parity: implement the expressible binary/appimage subset, refuse the rest with fixed text

decisions.title: Linux service start persistence
decisions.question: Does `services start` register a persistent systemd --user unit or run transiently?
decisions.default_policy: constrained-parity: document current transient start as the settled surface

decisions.title: Accepted-but-inert environment contracts
decisions.question: Which parsed-but-unread HOMEBREW_* variables and mirror domains are honored versus documented inert?
decisions.default_policy: constrained-parity: keep accepted-but-inert, documented, no silent behavior change

decisions.title: Cask behavior tranche granularity
decisions.question: How are cask query and mutation behaviors grouped into coherent parity tranches?
decisions.default_policy: constrained-parity: group by coherent observable behavior, queries before mutations

decisions.title: Shell completions surface
decisions.question: What completions surface reaches expressible parity across supported shells?
decisions.default_policy: constrained-parity: implement expressible completions parity by default

decisions.title: Output formatting parity bars
decisions.question: Which output formatting behaviors must match brew byte-for-byte versus best-effort?
decisions.default_policy: constrained-parity: match expressible output, keep architecture exclusions explicit

decisions.title: Shared install flag contracts
decisions.question: How are cask dry-run and other shared install flags accepted or refused across paths?
decisions.default_policy: constrained-parity: refuse unsupported flags by table rather than silently drop
